topography.project_purpose: vfat.io is a multi-chain yield aggregator built around the Sickle self-custodial smart-contract-wallet model. It helps users batch and automate yield-farming actions such as concentrated liquidity management, staking, and reward claiming across decentralized exchanges and chains, while users retain self-custody rather than depositing into a custodial vault-like strategy.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol uses SickleFactory to deploy user-specific Sickle contracts that interact with MasterChefV3 staking, NonfungiblePositionManager for liquidity management, and Gauge/Voter systems for reward distribution. Supporting registries and fee libraries provide configuration and fee handling across all core operations.
